faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about our courses, platform, and more.

items.question: How do I enroll in a course?
items.answer: Simply browse our course catalog, choose your preferred course, and click 'Enroll Now'. If you don't have an account yet, you'll be prompted to create one in seconds.

items.question: Can I get a refund for my course purchase?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a full 2-day money-back guarantee on course purchases if you're not completely satisfied with your learning experience.

items.question: Do you provide certificates?
items.answer: Yes! Upon successfully completing any course or specialization track, you will receive a verified, shareable digital certificate for your portfolio and LinkedIn profile.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and localized bank transfer options.

items.question: How do course purchases and batches work?
items.answer: When you buy a course, you get lifetime access to all learning materials, recorded lessons, and resources. You can also join live batches for interactive sessions with expert teachers.

items.question: Can I access courses on mobile?
items.answer: Yes, SkillBuild is fully responsive on all devices, and you can download our native iOS or Android mobile apps for offline learning.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: Our dedicated support team is available 24/7 via live chat, email at support@skillbuild.com, or through our community help forum.

items.question: Are the courses self-paced?
items.answer: Yes, all courses are 100% self-paced. You can start anytime, learn on your own schedule, and retain lifetime access to course materials.
